mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, user_id, run_id, workflow_id, workflow_version, definition_hash, trace_id, status, current_node_id, next_sequence, executed_steps, used_tokens, max_steps, token_budget, variables_json, revision, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO intelligent_workflow_run (tenant_id, user_id, run_id, workflow_id, workflow_version, definition_hash, trace_id, status, current_node_id, next_sequence, executed_steps, used_tokens, max_steps, token_budget, variables_json, revision, started_at, finished_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersion}, #{definitionHash}, #{traceId}, #{status}, #{currentNodeId}, #{nextSequence}, #{executedSteps}, #{usedTokens}, #{maxSteps}, #{tokenBudget}, #{variablesJson}, #{revision}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM intelligent_workflow_run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE intelligent_workflow_run SET status = #{run.status}, current_node_id = #{run.currentNodeId}, executed_steps = #{run.executedSteps}, used_tokens = #{run.usedTokens}, variables_json = #{run.variablesJson}, finished_at = #{run.finishedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{run.tenantId} AND user_id = #{run.userId} AND run_id = #{run.runId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE intelligent_workflow_run SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, revision = revision + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND run_id = #{runId} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_run_event (tenant_id, user_id, run_id, event_id, sequence, schema_version, event_type, node_execution_id, node_id, payload_json, trace_id, occurred_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{eventId}, #{sequence}, #{schemaVersion}, #{eventType}, #{nodeExecutionId}, #{nodeId}, #{payloadJson}, #{traceId}, #{occurredAt}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT event.id, event.tenant_id, event.user_id, event.run_id, event.event_id, event.sequence, event.schema_version, event.event_type, event.node_execution_id, event.node_id, event.payload_json, event.trace_id, event.occurred_at, event.expires_at FROM workflow_run_event event INNER JOIN chat_run run ON run.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND run.user_id = event.user_id AND run.run_id = event.run_id AND run.source_type = 'workflow' AND run.trace_id = event.trace_id AND run.deleted = 0 WHERE event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event.user_id = #{userId} AND event.run_id = #{runId} AND event.sequence > #{afterSequence} AND event.deleted = 0 AND event.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY event.sequence ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT MIN(event.sequence) FROM workflow_run_event event INNER JOIN chat_run run ON run.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND run.user_id = event.user_id AND run.run_id = event.run_id AND run.source_type = 'workflow' AND run.trace_id = event.trace_id AND run.deleted = 0 WHERE event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event.user_id = #{userId} AND event.run_id = #{runId} AND event.deleted = 0 AND event.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

SELECT event.id, event.tenant_id, event.user_id, event.run_id, event.event_id, event.sequence, event.schema_version, event.event_type, event.node_execution_id, event.node_id, event.payload_json, event.trace_id, event.occurred_at, event.expires_at FROM workflow_run_event event INNER JOIN chat_run run ON run.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND run.user_id = event.user_id AND run.run_id = event.run_id AND run.source_type = 'workflow' AND run.trace_id = event.trace_id AND run.deleted = 0 WHERE event.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event.user_id = #{userId} AND event.run_id = #{runId} AND event.event_type IN ('WORKFLOW_COMPLETED', 'WORKFLOW_FAILED', 'WORKFLOW_CANCELLED') AND event.deleted = 0 ORDER BY event.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
